senses.en_definition: Possibly the English proper name Loomis, notably a surname; the packet does not establish the intended referent.

etymology.historical_story: Loomis is documented as an English surname. Family-history accounts connect it with older place-based surname forms in Lancashire, although details of the historical interpretation vary. Such a name can appear unchanged inside a Malay sentence. That possibility explains the token without inventing a Malay root, but the packet alone cannot identify its bearer or establish a Malay dictionary meaning.
